description: Plan 9.1 acceptance. Signals use the plan 3.1 signal IDs. `final_value` and `cursor_value` read columns.f64 through the manifest's signal order; `compare` subtracts two models over a settled window.

checks.note: the readout the M1 Playwright test asserts
steady winding current, torque balance k*i = d*omega
same steady state as the iconic model
plan 9.1 (M2): the 1 ms PI reaches 100 +- 1 rad/s by t = 0.1 s (measured 99.996 rad/s, 0.09 s after the step at 0.01 s)
it is on the reference by t = 0.15 s (measured 100.000, no overshoot)
plan 9.1: |V| <= 24 V at every sample; the clamp holds the step at exactly 24.000 V
the +-24 V saturation is exercised on the reference step (peak exactly the 24 V clamp)
no overshoot beyond the 100 rad/s reference (measured peak 100.000 rad/s)
the winding current peaks at 11.03 A on the step (24 V / 2 ohm minus the back-EMF) and settles at the 2.0 mA load current
no solver failure, no connection/causality error and no event-limit stop

compare.note: the bond-graph Se is a constant 12 V, so only the settled part is comparable
